roundtrip.what: there and back: a printed price reads back as the same price
roundtrip.wrong_does: parse_price accepts one comma only: every price from 1,000,000.00 (two commas) is refused, although format_price prints it
roundtrip.trap_input: a price from 1,000,000.00; the contract's examples stop at 1,234.50

conserve.what: conservation: the shares of a bill add up to the bill
conserve.wrong_does: rounds the share half up and hands out only a positive remainder: when amount / people has a fraction of half a cent or more, everyone pays the rounded-up share and the sum is too large
conserve.trap_input: an amount that does not divide evenly and whose share rounds up (200.00 / 3, 0.01 / 2); the contract's example 100.00 / 3 rounds down and passes

idempotent.what: a repeat changes nothing: normalizing a normalized article number gives the same text
idempotent.wrong_does: collapses hyphens and underscores first and whitespace second: a space or tab next to a hyphen or underscore inside the text leaves several hyphens, which a second pass shortens
idempotent.trap_input: two kinds of separator in a row inside the text (`ab - 12`, `ab_ 12`); the contract's examples have runs of one kind

bound.what: a bound never crossed: nothing on the shelf goes below zero through holds and releases
bound.wrong_does: release checks the quantity against what is held only when something is held: on a shelf with nothing held any release goes through and `held` goes negative
bound.trap_input: a release on a shelf with nothing held; the contract's example releases too much from a shelf that holds 3

none.what: the control: a thin wrapper with no invariant — is one invented, and does the suite fail on the right implementation
